findings.message:
Reentrancy in TokenSender.run() (../sb/0xec329ffc97d75fe03428ae155fc7793431487f63.sol#87-109):
	External calls:
	- ! token.transfer(addr,transfers[mNext].amount) (../sb/0xec329ffc97d75fe03428ae155fc7793431487f63.sol#102)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- next = mNext (../sb/0xec329ffc97d75fe03428ae155fc7793431487f63.sol#108)
	TokenSender.next (../sb/0xec329ffc97d75fe03428ae155fc7793431487f63.sol#43) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- TokenSender.fill(uint256[]) (../sb/0xec329ffc97d75fe03428ae155fc7793431487f63.sol#66-83)
	- TokenSender.hasTerminated() (../sb/0xec329ffc97d75fe03428ae155fc7793431487f63.sol#116-120)
	- TokenSender.next (../sb/0xec329ffc97d75fe03428ae155fc7793431487f63.sol#43)
	- TokenSender.run() (../sb/0xec329ffc97d75fe03428ae155fc7793431487f63.sol#87-109)
findings.name: reentrancy-no-eth
